decision_rule_reachability.reason: All four cascade outcomes and all five fork values are logically reachable in the frozen runner. Positive/support branch: H1 SUPPORTED (G3 met, G1/ALTLEX met, selection_preserved, G2 gate-false solely on exclusive UP 10/12=0.8333<0.85) -> DECIDE_REQUIRE_RETRIEVAL_B, the deterministic expectation. Negative/decision-changing branches: (i) G2 flip to gate-met needs 11/12=0.9167>=0.85, a one-row margin, so H1-support and H1-falsify are adjacent, not empty; (ii) the retrieval fork is genuinely open because SELECT-feasibility (calibration rows) and the two TEST gate outcomes are independent -- all five combinations (INFEASIBLE / RETRIEVAL_DOMINATES / TFRAME_DOMINATES / BOTH_PASS / NEITHER) are reachable; (iii) all five MEASUREMENT_INVALID triggers are runner-enforced and reachable. Precedence is subsumption-free: the SCOPED elif (g2&selection_preserved) is reachable only when the first branch (g3&g2&selection_preserved) is false, i.e. g3 false, which is reachable. Thresholds are arithmetically attainable (G3 gate: <=2/20 OOS executes, >=18/36 app executes, UP>=0.85; parent TEST achieved FA 0.10/COV 1.0/UP 1.0, so attainable and non-ceiling on the discriminating axes; fit-pool bars measured 102/34/60 vs bars 78/20/20). Declared expected-unreachability of BROAD/SCOPED under deterministic no-refit reproduction is a predicted valid negative, not a structurally empty branch -- the one-row G2 margin keeps them triggerable in principle.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Five decision arms are operationally distinct implementations that can differ on the frozen task population: Arm A (B-LEX-STRONG + C1/C3/C4/C5/C6/C7), tframe_frozen (A minus C7 -- differs on the 2/4/2/1 OOS rows where C7 fires, changing pooled FA), incumbent (lexical S<=0 gate), gatefree (execute-all), and B-RETRIEVAL-OOS (pooled TF-IDF nearest-centroid with disjoint FIT-TRAIN/FIT-SELECT/TEST, sharing no fitted state with Arm A and never Arm A's cost denominator). Measured calibration headroom proves non-ceiling/non-floor: gatefree FA 0.30-0.60 vs Arm A 0.0; abstain-all reaches the coverage 0.0 floor while treatment holds 0.86-0.97 calibration coverage. No cost metric enters the decision rule, so no comparator uses an omitted cost dimension. Arm B's exclusive==inclusive equivalence (every scored row decision-conditional) is disclosed and harmonized cross-arm. Minor disclosed limitation, non-blocking: Arm A and tframe_frozen are identical on applicable-row metrics because C7 fires on 0 applicable rows; they remain distinguishable via pooled FA on OOS rows, which is the declared purpose of that diagnostic baseline.

nonblocking_findings: Retrieval SELECT gate is feasible with selective_acc=0.0 (independently reproduced: coverage 0.9412, FA 0.10, UP 0.9643, but 0 of 32 executed SELECT app rows correctly classified). The frozen gate criteria (FA<=0.10, COV>=0.50, UP>=0.85) exclude selective accuracy, so a BOTH_PASS_G3 or RETRIEVAL_DOMINATES_G3 fork could be declared on gate-level viability alone. The design pre-registers gate-level viability per RQF-05 and co-reports selective_acc for AUDIT adjudication (prereg #8.9); AUDIT must weigh selective_acc before reading a viability fork as product-viable retrieval.

H1-support is near-deterministic: the T-FRAME+ analysis logic is byte-identical to the audited parent lineage apart from a metadata-only repair, and the frozen banks are unchanged since the parent freeze (hashes verified against parent freeze.json). The experiment's discriminating power therefore rests on the one-row G2 exclusive margin (10/12 vs 11/12 around the 0.85 bar) and the honest-retrieval fork; BROAD/SCOPED are expected-unreachable in practice. This is the mandate's own question and the falsifier is genuine, but the design correctly discloses it (prereg #8.10) and no redesign is warranted at review time.

G3 TEST gate components coverage and UP were 1.0 in the parent run (near-ceiling on two of three components), while pooled_false_accept sits exactly at the 0.10 bar (2/20 OOS executes), making the G3 gate one-OOS-execution sensitive on FA only. Falsification load is correctly placed on the G2 margin and the retrieval fork; disclosed, non-blocking.
